arguments.value: MediaCo agreed to let WBLS-WLIB LLC rebroadcast WLIB-AM’s programming on WQHT-FM’s HD2 digital channel, except Sunday mornings from 6:00 to 8:00 a.m. The agreement ran from November 25, 2019 until the earliest of December 31, 2022, termination of the studio lease, early notice by Programmer, or mutual written termination. WBLS-WLIB had to supply the programming, cover all production and delivery costs, and obtain needed music licenses, while MediaCo had to broadcast the programming and kept final control over station operations, FCC compliance, and whether to preempt or reject content. Programmer could not separately sell advertising, but could market the show as airing on the HD2 channel, and no fee was owed to MediaCo. The agreement also addresses political advertising compliance, indemnification, default and termination rights, assignment limits, force majeure, and other standard contract terms.
